strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Phase Reduction

Uses 8-10 dispatches (8 AR + optional compact/scatter) but reduces effective bandwidth on later stages by exploiting sparsity in the mask pattern.

Uses 16 dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but exposes parallelism across blocks and may hide latency through pipeline fill.
